SELECT s1.friend_id, COUNT(s2.id) AS student_count
FROM students s1
INNER JOIN students s2 ON s1.friend_id = s2.friend_id
GROUP BY s1.friend_id
ORDER BY s1.friend_id;

prompt: In a student table with friendships, find students who have friends that are also friends with each other (3 way friendship). Return student_id, name, and their mutual friend's name, sorted by student_id and mutual_friend_name.

SELECT s1.id AS student_id, s1.name AS student_name, s2.name AS mutual_friend_name
FROM students s1

WHERE s1.id <> s2.id
ORDER BY s1.id, mutual_friend_name;
